basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/QCryptonPQCProxy/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. QCrypton PQC Proxy is a hybrid post-quantum TLS 1.3 reverse proxy (X25519MLKEM768) that protects traffic against harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. This Microsoft Sentinel solution ingests handshake telemetry from PQC Proxy instances, enabling detection of PQC downgrade attacks, certificate health monitoring, and post-quantum adoption tracking across your infrastructure. Ships with 1 data connector, 6 analytic rules, workbook, and Teams-notification playbook. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs: • [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://aka.ms/Sentinel-CCP_Platform) **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 6, **Playbooks:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.

elements.name: workbook1
elements.label: QCrypton PQC Proxy — Hybrid Post-Quantum TLS Dashboard

options.text: Hybrid post-quantum TLS dashboard for PQC Proxy instances. Visualises PQC adoption rates, key exchange group distribution, downgrade events, certificate health, and per-proxy metrics from QCrypton PQC Proxy telemetry.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: PQC downgrade detected - client offered hybrid but classical was negotiated

options.text:
A TLS handshake completed where the client offered a post-quantum hybrid key exchange group
(X25519MLKEM768 or X25519Kyber768Draft00) but the negotiation fell back to a classical group
(X25519 or P-256). This may indicate a misconfigured PQC Proxy, a middlebox stripping PQC
groups from ClientHello, or an active downgrade attack. Investigate the proxy configuration
and network path between client and proxy.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: PQC Proxy certificate expiring within 30 days

options.text:
A PQC Proxy instance is serving a TLS certificate that expires within the next 30 days.
Certificate renewal should be performed before expiry to avoid service disruption. If the
certificate is renewed, ensure the replacement uses a PQ-hybrid or classical algorithm
compatible with TLS 1.3 and the configured key exchange groups.

elements.name: analytic3
elements.label: PQC Proxy certificate expiring within 7 days - immediate renewal required

options.text:
A PQC Proxy instance is serving a TLS certificate that expires within the next 7 days.
Immediate certificate renewal is required to prevent service outage. Clients will receive
TLS errors once the certificate expires, breaking all PQC-protected connections through
this proxy.

elements.name: analytic4
elements.label: TLS handshake failure spike on PQC Proxy

options.text:
An elevated rate of TLS handshake failures was detected on a PQC Proxy instance within the
last hour. This may indicate clients using incompatible TLS libraries, expired or invalid
certificates, a denial-of-service attempt, or network-level interference with the TLS
handshake. Investigate the error messages and client IPs to determine the root cause.

elements.name: analytic5
elements.label: Upstream backend connection failures on PQC Proxy

options.text:
A PQC Proxy instance is experiencing elevated upstream connection failures when forwarding
requests to its backend service. This may indicate the backend is down, overloaded, or
unreachable. While the PQC Proxy TLS termination is functioning correctly, clients will
receive 502/504 errors until the backend recovers.

elements.name: analytic6
elements.label: High percentage of clients connecting without PQC support

options.text:
More than 50% of TLS handshakes on a PQC Proxy instance in the last 24 hours used classical
(non-PQC) key exchange because clients did not offer any post-quantum groups. This is an
adoption tracking signal - these clients are not protected against harvest-now-decrypt-later
attacks. Consider requiring client TLS library upgrades or communicating PQC requirements
to connecting services.

This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
